reason: The description captures the main task but has a misleading point about the dispatched logic (presence vs. non-null check) and omits explicit wrapping of map values into domain ID types.
missing_functionality: Explicit wrapping of ID map values into DeliveryId and OrderId types
incorrect_or_misleading_points: The dispatched logic states 'true when it is present and false when it is null', but the implementation checks delivery.get("dispatched") != null, meaning true only if the value is not null, not just key presence.
